title: OpenHydro Bench (benchmark1d2d): open verification and validation benchmarks for 1D, 2D and coupled hydraulic models
description: An open, engine-agnostic suite that scores flood, drainage and pipe-network models against exact solutions, conservation laws, laboratory and field measurements, and the pinned EPA SWMM 5.2.4 and EPANET 2.2 reference engines. Every result is a signed score card; production codes (HEC-RAS 6.6, TELEMAC-2D, ANUGA, GeoClaw, LISFLOOD-FP, EPA SWMM, OpenSWMM, Hydra) are run as black boxes, and results submitted by other developers are scored with the same limits.
